narr: A slow moving frontal boundary triggers shower and thunderstorms with heavy rainfall on the afternoon of the 7th. The anomalously humid airmass resulted in torrential rainfall rates around 2 to 3 inches per hour and localized flooding across the mountains of western Maine.
ev: Public reported a washout on Goodrich Road near Jackson Brook. Minor washout on Murray Street near McLaughlin Lane. Radar estimated 1 to 3 inches of rain fell across the Bingham Area in the course of an hour and a half.
